answer: Sybil resistance rests on stake bonds, not names. Each agent locks a bond, answers the epoch challenge with a signed proof, and unrelated peers re-check it. Duplicates from one operator are caught statistically: correlated timing and identical fingerprints form a ripple in the attestation graph. A forged identity costs a full bond and every proven duplicate burns it, so n puppets need n bonds at risk against one detection; expected loss exceeds reward. Cost per identity, crystal clear, is the barrier: a karst of hollow references pays nothing, and a duplicate reputation dies with its bond.
